description:
Copper Auburn with Blonde Money Piece | Dimensional Color Melt

100% Brazilian Virgin Remy Human Hair, professionally custom-colored by Mia Kelly. Features a beautiful blend of rich copper auburn tones with warm, dimensional color throughout. Soft, buttery blonde face-framing highlights create a striking money piece, adding brightness and contrast around the face. Finished with a seamless color melt and long, flowing waves for a vibrant, luxurious look.

Photos are taken in natural lighting to showcase the true color and dimension of the hair.

Mia's professional products of choice include Schwarzkopf IGORA ROYAL hair color, Redken toners, and Kenra Professional haircare and styling products.

Every wig is personally inspected by Mia Kelly throughout the coloring, washing, and styling process to ensure professional quality.

Because this is 100% human hair, care for and style her just like your natural hair. She arrives professionally colored and styled, but shipping may affect the finished look. Light restyling may be needed after unboxing.

Washing and care instructions are included with purchase.

Ready to Ship | One of a Kind | Only One Available

Please Note: All Sales Are Final.
features: ADJUSTABLE DRAWSTRING, SILICONE PADDING, 4 COMBS, REMOVABLE BAND, HD DIAMOND LACE, GLUELESS WEAR & GO
